correctness.rationale: The C5 column shift acts freely on nonempty rook placements of 4x5 chessboard complex; quotient is a Delta-complex retaining all cell multiplicities, not an abstract vertex-set complex. Independently enumerated all 20,120,240,120 source faces and 4,24,48,24 orbit cells, built all signed quotient boundary matrices, verified both d²=0, and computed exact Smith invariants for d1 (1^3), d2 (1^20,5), d3 (1^23) via integer Smith normal form. This gives H_i(Z)=(Z,Z/5,Z^4,Z) for i=0..3, zero higher. Independently evaluated canonical column-difference edge cochain u and integer lift B=(δU)/5 on 24 top orbit cells against the primitive ±1 top cycle; sum is exactly integer 2, nonzero mod5. H^1(Y;Z)=0, so β_Z u is nontrivial 5-torsion; wedge Moore + four 2-spheres + 3-sphere has vanishing such degree3 cross-product. No extrapolation beyond this finite quotient.
